title: Towards Multi-Objective Routing: A Novel Coreset-based Transfer Learning Framework
problem: Routing optimization with multiple conflicting objectives (timing, power, wirelength) traditionally trades quality for optimization time.
motivation: Efficient multi-objective routing enables better design tradeoff exploration without excessive computation time.
method: Coreset-based transfer learning framework for multi-objective routing. Reduces training data requirements while preserving routing quality. Enables knowledge transfer across routing problems.
key_novelty: First coreset-based transfer learning approach for multi-objective circuit routing.
limitations: Specific routing objectives evaluated not detailed; generalization to emerging routing challenges unclear.
primary_theme: Coreset-based transfer learning for multi-objective routing
